records.jp: うーん
records.en_original: Hmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmm...
records.en: Hmmm...

records.jp: で、作業室に用事って？
records.en_original: You wanted me to join you in the work room?
records.en_auxiliary: You wanted me to join you in the work room?
records.en: You wanted me to join you in the work room?

records.jp: 今週一週間の献立を決めておこうと思ったんですが……
records.en_original: I've been thinking about what to make for our meals this week.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been thinking about what to make for our meals this week.
records.en: I've been thinking about what to make for our meals this week.

records.jp: 食材の種類に限りがあるので、<CR>そろそろバリエーションが尽きてしまいそうで
records.en_original: Our rations are limited and we're beginning to run low on some things. It's hard to have much variation at this point.
records.en_auxiliary: Our rations are limited and we're beginning to run low on some things. It's hard to have much variation at this point.
records.en: We only have so many kinds of ingredients,<CR>so I'm starting to run out of different dishes to make.

records.jp: でもできるだけ飽きが来ないようにしたいですし……
records.en_original: I don't want you all getting sick of your food.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want you all getting sick of your food.
records.en: I don't want you all getting sick of your food.

records.jp: 星崎さん、何か食べたいものありますか？
records.en_original: Do you have anything you want to eat, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have anything you want to eat, Ao?
records.en: Do you have anything you want to eat, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: この前食べた唐揚げかな。<CR>あれめっちゃ美味しかったからまた食べたいなぁ
records.en_original: The fried chicken you made before! It was sooo good.
records.en_auxiliary: The fried chicken you made before! It was sooo good.
records.en: The karaage we had before.<CR>It was so good, I want it again.

records.jp: 気に入りました？<CR>結構工夫したんですよ、あれ
records.en_original: You liked it? That took quite a bit of planning, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: You liked it? That took quite a bit of planning, you know?
records.en: Did you like it?<CR>I put quite a lot of ingenuity into that dish.

records.jp: ちゃんと唐揚げだと思えるようになるまでいろいろと。<CR>ふふ、楽しかったなあ
records.en_original: It took a very long time until it started actually resembling chicken. Hehe, that was fun.
records.en_auxiliary: It took a very long time until it started actually resembling chicken. Hehe, that was fun.
records.en: I tried all sorts of things until it tasted like proper karaage.<CR>Hehe, it was fun.

records.jp: （……詳しくは聞くまい）
records.en_original: (...Something tells me I shouldn't ask about the details.)
records.en_auxiliary: (...Something tells me I shouldn't ask about the details.)
records.en: (...Something tells me I shouldn't ask about the details.)

records.jp: 味付け変えるとかは？　<CR>私久しぶりにエスニック料理食べたいなぁ
records.en_original: What about switching up the flavors? Try out some other cuisines?
records.en_auxiliary: What about switching up the flavors? Try out some other cuisines?
records.en: What about changing up the flavors?<CR>I haven't had ethnic food in a while.

records.jp: エスニックかぁ……あの風味をここで取れる食材で<CR>出すのはやりがいがありそうですね！
records.en_original: Other cuisines? ...It's going to be challenging to get other flavors from the ingredients we get here!
records.en_auxiliary: Other cuisines? ...It's going to be challenging to get other flavors from the ingredients we get here!
records.en: Ethnic food... Reproducing those flavors with ingredients<CR>we can obtain here sounds like a worthwhile challenge!

records.jp: できるの？
records.en_original: You can do that?
records.en_auxiliary: You can do that?
records.en: You can do that?

records.jp: いろんな香りを抜き足しすれば何とか。<CR>料理というより、実験じみてますけど
records.en_original: I think I can manage by playing around with different aromas. Though it might be closer to experimentation than cooking!
records.en_auxiliary: I think I can manage by playing around with different aromas. Though it might be closer to experimentation than cooking!
records.en: I should manage by adding and removing different aromas.<CR>Though it may be closer to an experiment than cooking.

records.jp: 料理のおいしさには香りが重要です。<CR>やってみせますよ！
records.en_original: Food is all about the aroma after all! I'll do what I can!
records.en_auxiliary: Food is all about the aroma after all! I'll do what I can!
records.en: Food is all about the aroma after all!<CR>I'll do what I can!

records.jp: もし何か試作するなら、声かけてね。<CR>味見くらいならするから
records.en_original: Let me know if you need a guinea pig. I'd happily volunteer.
records.en_auxiliary: Let me know if you need a guinea pig. I'd happily volunteer.
records.en: Call me if you make any test batches.<CR>I can at least taste them for you.

records.jp: そうですね。せっかく二人でいるのに<CR>考え事ばかりもなんですし、作っちゃいますか
records.en_original: Of course! No point standing around, let's get started, shall we?
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! No point standing around, let's get started, shall we?
records.en: That's true. Since it's just the two of us,<CR>there's no point standing around thinking. Shall we make it?

records.en_original: Hmm, hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, hmm...
records.en: Hmm, hmm...

records.jp: （鼻歌歌ってる……私いるんだけどな。<CR>もしかして無意識？）
records.en_original: (Shiho's humming... I wonder if she forgot I was here. Or maybe she doesn't realize she's doing it.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Shiho's humming... I wonder if she forgot I was here. Or maybe she doesn't realize she's doing it.)
records.en: (She's humming... even though I'm right here.<CR>Is she doing it without realizing?)

records.jp: それ、なんの曲だっけ？
records.en_original: What song is that?
records.en_auxiliary: What song is that?
records.en: What song is that?

records.jp: えと……なんの曲でもないというか……<CR>わたしオリジナルです
records.en_original: Oh... It's actually one I made up myself.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... It's actually one I made up myself.
records.en: Oh... It's actually one I<CR>made up myself.

records.jp: そうなんだ。<CR>どこかで聞いた感じがするなって思ったけど
records.en_original: Oh, yeah? Feels like I've heard it somewhere before.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, yeah? Feels like I've heard it somewhere before.
records.en: Oh, yeah?<CR>Feels like I've heard it somewhere before.

records.jp: 流行りのCDとかよく聞くので、<CR>それが影響してるのかもしれないです
records.en_original: I do listen to a lot of pop music, maybe that influenced me.
records.en_auxiliary: I do listen to a lot of pop music, maybe that influenced me.
records.en: I do listen to a lot of pop<CR>music, maybe that influenced me.

records.en_original: Hmm, hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, hmm...
records.en: Hmm, hmm...

records.jp: もう、やめてください……。<CR>なんだかはずかしい
records.en_original: Stop that... It's embarrassing...
records.en_auxiliary: Stop that... It's embarrassing...
records.en: Stop that... It's<CR>embarrassing...

records.jp: 手伝えることある？
records.en_original: Is there anything I can help you with?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything I can help you with?
records.en: Is there anything I can help you with?

records.jp: いえ、大丈夫です。<CR>そこで待っていてください
records.en_original: No, I'm fine. You can just wait.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm fine. You can just wait.
records.en: No, I'm fine.<CR>You can just wait.

records.jp: いやでもさ、ただ待ってるだけというのも気が引けて
records.en_original: I feel kinda awkward just sitting around while you do all the work.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel kinda awkward just sitting around while you do all the work.
records.en: I feel kinda awkward just sitting around while you do all the work.

records.jp: ダメです！<CR>料理はわたしの仕事ですから！
records.en_original: No! Cooking is my job!
records.en_auxiliary: No! Cooking is my job!
records.en: No!<CR>Cooking is my responsibility!

records.jp: そ、そこまで怒らなくても
records.en_original: Y-you don't have to get so upset.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you don't have to get so upset.
records.en: Y-you don't have to get so upset.

records.jp: う……すみません。<CR>どうしても家事周りには熱くなってしまって
records.en_original: Ah... I'm so sorry. I just get worked up when it comes to housework.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... I'm so sorry. I just get worked up when it comes to housework.
records.en: Ah... I'm so sorry. I<CR>just get worked up when it comes to housework.

records.jp: どうですか？
records.en_original: How is it?
records.en_auxiliary: How is it?
records.en: How is it?

records.jp: 完璧！<CR>このままお店で出せるレベル
records.en_original: It's perfect! This is restaurant level stuff!
records.en_auxiliary: It's perfect! This is restaurant level stuff!
records.en: It's perfect!<CR>This is restaurant level stuff!

records.jp: 本当ですか？<CR>よかったです～
records.en_original: Really? I'm so happy you like it!
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I'm so happy you like it!
records.en: Really? I'm so<CR>happy you like it!

records.jp: あ、忘れないうちに配分をメモしないと！
records.en_original: Oh, I've got to write down the recipe before I forget!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I've got to write down the recipe before I forget!
records.en: Oh, I've got to write down the recipe before I forget!

records.jp: 毎回こうやってメモしてんの？
records.en_original: Do you always write your recipes down?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you always write your recipes down?
records.en: Do you write it down like this every time?

records.jp: はい、小学生の頃から
records.en_original: Yes, ever since elementary school.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, ever since elementary school.
records.en: Yes, ever since elementary school.

records.jp: 料理上手は１日してならず、ってことか……
records.en_original: A recipe a day is the master chef's way... Or something.
records.en_auxiliary: A recipe a day is the master chef's way... Or something.
records.en: So I guess becoming a good cook doesn't happen overnight...

records.jp: 好き
records.en_original: I'm in love.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm in love.
records.en: I love it.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: これ、大好き！<CR>食べちゃうのがもったいない！
records.en_original: I'm in love with your cooking! I could eat it every day for the rest of my life!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm in love with your cooking! I could eat it every day for the rest of my life!
records.en: I love this!<CR>It almost feels too precious to eat!

records.jp: あ、ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Th-thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thank you.
records.en: Th-thank you.

records.jp: ふう、びっくりした……
records.en_original: Phew, you surprised me...
records.en_auxiliary: Phew, you surprised me...
records.en: Phew... You startled me.

records.jp: ん？　どうかした？
records.en_original: Huh? What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What's wrong?
records.en: Huh? What's wrong?

records.jp: な、何でもないです！
records.en_original: N-nothing!
records.en_auxiliary: N-nothing!
records.en: N-nothing!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
